summary: The trace revealed several patterns not fully covered in the existing skill: (1) selector workbook pattern for monthly data with source/version preferences, (2) handling missing monthly values by averaging only available months, (3) series-specific deflator columns, (4) status_bucket as another status flag variant, and (5) register file pattern with history_code/current_code columns. These are incremental additions to the existing economic-time-series-analysis skill.
